assumption: Frontier models directly complete a growing share of digital functions without launching conventional applications.
leading_signals: measured model-native quality exceeds software route
lower energy and latency on repeated tasks
planner_implication: admit MODEL_NATIVE as a first-class route but require task-specific quality evidence
retirement_trigger: persistent failure, high rework energy, or loss of reproducibility

assumption: APIs and agent protocols remain the most reliable and governable machine interfaces.
planner_implication: prefer API when it is feasible and resource-efficient
retirement_trigger: interface unavailable, excessive price, or direct route materially outperforms it

assumption: Computer-use routes become reliable enough to serve as normal fallbacks or, in some tasks, primary routes.
planner_implication: treat GUI as a capability surface, never as a permission grant
retirement_trigger: error compounding, interface drift, or excess energy relative to alternatives

assumption: Authorized machines and organizations expose metered functions that other agents can borrow.
planner_implication: discover and quote remote capabilities under explicit data and payment limits
retirement_trigger: trust failure, adverse economics, jurisdictional conflict, or unreliable delivery

assumption: Energy, privacy, bandwidth, or resilience constraints make local compact functions preferable.
planner_implication: prioritize licensed internalization and local execution after correctness gates
retirement_trigger: local route fails quality, safety, or maintenance economics

assumption: Models can traverse more interfaces while identity, data, legal, and payment rights remain independently controlled.
planner_implication: block any route that confuses operability with authority
retirement_trigger: none as a default safety invariant; revise only if the permission model itself changes by explicit contract
